instruction.text: You're standing in a tiled room, in front of you you see a mirror between two lights. If you turn around you see a gray couch on the right and to the left of it a circular table. Take a step between the couch and table. And then take a step towards the stairs on the left. Go all the way up the stairs. And take a step towards the double doors you see. And then turn to the right and walk down this hallway take two steps. And then you should see some stairs to your left, take another two steps down the hallway. And you should be standing in front of a bedroom, take a step towards the bed. And then take a step over the bed onto the rug in front of it. And standing in front of the bed you should see a brown shelf and desk and to the left is a TV and you've reached the end.
